brief:
The American Arab University held a white coat ceremony for students enrolled in its College of Dentistry at its campus in Ramallah, Maan Wire reported. The event marks a traditional milestone for dental students entering clinical practice phases of their education.

White coat ceremonies are widely observed in dental and medical programs as formal rites of passage, symbolizing students' transition toward professional practice and their commitment to ethical standards in healthcare.
title: American Arab University holds white coat ceremony for dental students
